note: Hand-authored: the installed omd CLI (v0.18.0) does not expose a `ref usage`/`recordReferenceUsage` subcommand (confirmed via `omd --help`), so this ledger was written directly by the coordinator/finalizer from the actual shipped build, following the reference-assembly protocol's row schema in spirit.

rows.evidence: Kinetic-type two-weight headline (500→800) replacing the prior 3-slide autoplay stock-photo hero, paired with a quiet inline evidence-numeral row (20+ hospitals / 100% licensed) instead of a boxed panel.

Explicit rejection condition honored: no price-forward product-thumbnail carousel, no footer-only regulatory text — the prior rotating stock-photo hero was removed and no marketplace-grid pattern was introduced anywhere on the page.
Five-stop chronological rail (2017–2025), each stop pairing a year with a real registration/patent/GMP fact as plain text, per the dated-milestone-timeline anatomy.

Two label-above-title category cards (수술용 기기 / 소모성 의료용품) reusing the site's existing `.product-card__category` convention, strengthened in round 1 with distinct per-card borders/background so they read as separate masses.
Numbered 01–04 horizontal rail restating the real 4-step 수탁 정산 방식 flow from about.html, one claim per step.
Clearly-primary (회사소개 filled button) vs. quiet secondary links (제품소개/문의하기) plus a plain-text credential line, replacing the prior two-equal-weight CTA cards.
